reason: B offers the more substantive extension: deposition-controlled grain refinement provides a direct comparison and a plausible nucleation-barrier mechanism for reducing first-order transition hysteresis while retaining a high-area deposited form. A largely transfers an already published annealing–defect–exchange-distribution explanation from a chemically and magnetically different, second-order HEA system; however, B still needs tighter grain-size/order boundaries, and grain refinement alone does not necessarily increase external surface-to-volume ratio.
